events.description: While drilling meter 5717M, observed decrease in penetration time of 9 MIN per meter. Subsequently drilled meter by meter from 5717M to 5719M lifting string for safety, lifting free. Controlled torque parameters 17,000-19,000 FT-LB and WOB: 5 TON.
Observed resistance to return to bottom from 5718.6 to 5719M with torque of 17,000 - 19,000 FT-LB.
Decided to lift string to 5690M to recover bottom sample and characterize with geology.
Increased mud density from 2.0 GR/CC to 2.02 GR/CC.
Lifted with circulation and without rotation to 5,712 M to verify weights, free. String weights: STATIC 206 TON, UP 222 TON, OFF-BOTTOM TQ 13,500 FT-LB.
Suspended after obtaining 100 continuous hours of drilling to perform short trip according to program.
Observed loss of signal from HTTA MWD at 5752M. Performed antijamming test successfully recovering tool signal (MWD).

Lifted string and bit 10 5/8" from 5,719 to 5,692 M to circulate well and recover bottom sample and characterize by geology.
